title: Nonpoisoned metal catalysts enabled by concave carbon confinement for durable sulfur conversion in batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,982-994
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05654C, Paper
Linkai Peng, Tongxin Shang, Junwei Han, Jiwei Shi, Chuannan Geng, Yaqi He, Mengyao Li, Yun Cao, Wongsathorn Kaewraung, Min Gao, Yan-Bing He, Quan-Hong Yang, Wei Lv
A carbon confinement strategy stabilizes Co catalysts against sulfur poisoning via balanced Co2+/Co0 valence. This enables a 1.5 Ah Li–S pouch cells to deliver a high energy density of 457 Wh kg−1 with only 0.32% per-cycle fade over 80 cycles.
